current_manuscript_architecture.note: The S7 documentation layer uses the current architecture. The shipped PDF has not been regenerated to match, so the findings below stand against the artifact, not the architecture.

headline_finding: The manuscript's q_rec result (Results 1.5, Fig. 4b, Supplementary S7.8) is the branch this repository retired on 2026-09-02 for target-provenance leakage and for having no skill over a persistence baseline.
architecture_finding: The shipped Results 1.1 carries the flat 8-tuple contract with no claim-core / operational-epoch distinction and no defect/reconciliation machinery; a text search finds zero occurrences of the current vocabulary.

retirement.retired_branch: q_rec target I_p, 141 coordinates, 7 development / 55 external, REL10 / REL141 / RAW10

grounds.detail: 6/10 REL10 and 4/10 RAW10 features carry upstream I_p dependence; q95 is essentially shape*a^2*Bt/I_p (median |corr| 0.945 with 1/I_p, 7.3% residual scatter, I_p recovered at median R^2 0.79).
persistence median normalised RMSE 0.0685 beats REL141 0.1137, REL10 0.1257 and RAW10 0.1821; var(eval)/var(calib) median 0.0032.

statements.statement: K_q = (q, I_q, P_q, B_q, H_q, U_q, V_q, Omega_q) as one flat tuple
statements.proposed_correction: Split into K_q^(e) = (K_q^claim, K_q^op,(e)) with K^claim = (q, I_q, U_q, V_q, Omega_q) and K^op,(e) = (P_q, B_q, H_q).

statements.statement: data reserved for final validation must not influence the revised ontology or search policy
statements.proposed_correction: Replace with the protected-evidence rule: inspected evaluation evidence becomes development evidence for the revised epoch; a later qualification must use new protected evidence, a valid cross-fitted design, or an explicitly narrowed claim.

statements.statement: Sigma_q = SearchPolicy(G_q, K_q); ontology != universe != frontier != policy
statements.proposed_correction: None. S7 instantiates the distinction: G_q (S7.5H) != A_q 10778 (S7.6R) != Ahat_q 162845 (S7.7R) != Sigma_q.

statements.statement: a construction absent from the explored frontier is not thereby shown inadmissible, inferior or nonexistent
statements.proposed_correction: None. S7.9 records global_optimality_claim=false, unsearched_status=ADMISSIBLE_UNSEARCHED.

statements.statement: no audit/reconciliation machinery (delta, rho, j_min)
statements.proposed_correction: Add. S7.R1 is the concrete instance: earliest_invalidated_stage = NONE_OF_THE_INSTANTIATED_OBJECTS; K_REC_REVISION_REQUIRED = true; minimal component P_rec.

statements.statement: no scientific-task / claim-branch / operational-epoch hierarchy
statements.proposed_correction: Add. Without it the q_rec lineage cannot be stated: S7 has one task, two claim branches (QREC-B1, QREC-B2) and three operational epochs.

statements.statement: no descendant-claim-branch disposition
statements.proposed_correction: Add. It is what the Epoch-1 to Epoch-2 transition actually is: a material narrowing of V_q after protected evidence was spent, producing a provenance-linked descendant branch under an unchanged q.

statements.statement: I_q and V_q are not clearly separated, and evidence roles are treated as global per datum
statements.proposed_correction: Separate them: I_q = what information is epistemically admissible; V_q = what evidentiary role it may play. Roles are variable- and transition-specific; S7's predictor-side applicability versus target-side discovery is the worked example.
